resources.string: Set a daily reminder to check out the cards you found during the day!
Permission to send notifications is required to give you daily reminders. Please grant the required permissions in the system settings of the application.

Adjust how many steps are required to find a card. This allows you to play the game at your own pace with respect to your body's ability.\n\nSetting the multiplier to 0.0 allows you to open one pack of each active set whenever you want.

Save your progress and user preferences by exporting it to a file. Move that file somewhere safe to prevent loss of progress. Restore your data by importing it again. You can also transfer your progress to a different device this way.
Importing data will permanently overwrite your current progress. This cannot be reverted and your current progress will be unrecoverably lost.\n\nAre you sure you want to continue?
